provenance.operation: Move six base-balance components at every sample from weighted penalties into normalized equality constraints, preserving all other residuals, the targeted grid, CAD/contact parameters and bounds.
provenance.normalized_equality_tolerance: 0.1 times existing physical force/moment gate; final physical audit still required.
provenance.solver: Dense IDTO-style constrained Gauss-Newton dogleg, checked Schur solve with SVD fallback for consistent rank deficiency; bounds shorten steps. No contact schedule or online MPC.
provenance.limitations: Finite local solve with numerical derivatives. Dense temporal checks, motor/penetration gates, collision, slip and runtime stability remain independent.
provenance.numerical_change: When the Schur solve fails its residual check, factor A L^{-T} directly with SVD (H=L L^T), avoiding the squared condition number of the normal equations. Same optimization data, bounds, tolerances and budget.
provenance.globalization: Radially shorten the same constrained Newton step and use an exact L1 merit function with nondecreasing weight above the multiplier infinity norm. Same initial motion, bounds, physical properties, equality tolerance and iteration budget. This differs from the paper-style signed-Lagrangian dogleg.
provenance.experiment: Feasibility restoration only: unweighted normalized balance, motor-envelope violation and penetration. Same CAD, contact, period and motion basis. Fix both cycle displacements to parent values; task, effort and sliding-work costs excluded. No physical gate relaxed.
